title: build-console: objectui's @objectstack/* install from this framework tree when the pin carries .objectstack-sha (ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectui#12955)
body:
Fixes #24306
Clause-②: no

Ruling B on objectstack-ai/objectui#12955 (comment `6248859734`), step 3. objectui consumes `@objectstack/*` by commit since objectstack-ai/objectui#12957 landed as `749ed760`: its root `package.json` overrides seven packages (spec, core, types, client, formula, sdui-parser, lint) to `file:node_modules/.cache/objectstack/NAME`, and its `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs build` fills those directories. With `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT=TREE` set, that script packs an installed and built objectstack tree instead of building its own pin, with no lockfile change.

`scripts/build-console.sh` now uses that input. Until this lands, `.objectui-sha` cannot move past `749ed760`: the console build's frozen install of objectui dies there.

## What changed

One file of behaviour, `scripts/build-console.sh`, plus one test.

- **Detection by the file.** When the pinned objectui carries `.objectstack-sha`, a new block runs before objectui's frozen install. A pin without the file never enters it (Done-when item 2).
- **Refusal without the hook.** A pin with `.objectstack-sha` whose `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs` is missing or has no `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT` input exits 1, naming the hook, like the existing `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST` / `OBJECTSTACK_CLIENT_DIST` guards (item 3).
- **The closure build.** It builds the packages objectui overrides, read from objectui's root `package.json` at the pin, through turbo (`^build` brings their dependencies). In every workflow that runs this script this is a cache hit (measured below), and `--output-logs=new-only` keeps a hit from replaying about 3,600 cached log lines.
- **Declarations whatever `OS_SKIP_DTS` says.** That build runs with `OS_SKIP_DTS` unset and says so when the caller had it set. See the consumer pointer section below.
- **The stand-in.** It runs `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT=FRAMEWORK_ROOT node scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs build` in the objectui checkout, then the unchanged frozen install. Every `@objectstack/*` package objectui installs is then this tree's (item 1).
- **The refusal text.** On a pin-script refusal the build stops before the install. The text names what an operator does when the reason is a dependency mismatch (this tree added or dropped a runtime dependency of one of the seven after objectui's pin): the fix is objectui's. Move objectui's `.objectstack-sha`, commit the lockfile (and any override) that needs, land it, then move `.objectui-sha` here. ⛔ Not by editing the scratch lockfile or making the install non-frozen.
- `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST` / `OBJECTSTACK_CLIENT_DIST` stay: older pins still install from npm and need them.

**Not changed:** `.objectui-sha` (item 5: the bump that follows is this card's verification), any workflow, anything in objectui.

## The consumer pointer on this card (`6257693480`, `repo:cloud#2`)

It measured, on objectstack-ai/cloud#3023, that objectui's pin script refuses an `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` (typeless) tree, and that the rebuild its refusal prints inherits the same `OS_SKIP_DTS`.

- **Who sets it on the way to this script, measured here:** no workflow, composite action, `package.json` script, shell script or Dockerfile in this repository (`git grep OS_SKIP_DTS`: readers only). It is a developer's or agent's local speed flag (AGENTS.md mentions it), and cloud's lane.
- **Reproduced on this branch before the fix**, at `f106564740`, `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`, all seven built typeless: exit 1, `@objectstack/client is not built in TREE: its manifest points at dist/index.d.ts, which is not there`.
- **Choice: build with declarations, not refuse up front.**
  - Business need: nobody in this repo sets it before this script, so the case is a local caller; building serves them in one run, refusing makes them re-run.
  - Long-term fit: the script already owns this closure build, and the pin contract needs complete packages; the contract is not loosened, the script produces the input the contract asks for.
  - AI error-proofing: an agent that exported `OS_SKIP_DTS` can no longer reach a refusal whose printed remedy loops; the override is announced, not silent.
  - Scope: three lines, no new gate.
- `turbo.json` lists `OS_SKIP_DTS` in `globalEnv`, so the unset build hashes apart from a typeless one and cannot replay it. The proof is on disk, not turbo's word: see the measurements.

## Measurements (each command with its exit code, captured before any pipe)

Shared 4-core box; wall-clock figures are shared-box readings. The objectui trees were scratch clones under the session scratchpad (`OBJECTUI_ROOT`). ⛔ The shared `../objectui` checkout was not touched. `.objectui-sha` was set locally only, and restored by a trap that compared blob hashes with `HEAD`. Every run ended with `git diff HEAD` empty and a clean `git status`.

**Item 4, new branch, objectui `749ed760`, the CI way, at `f106564740`:**

| step | command | exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client... --concurrency=2` | 0 |
| B | `OBJECTUI_ROOT=SCRATCH bash scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit --no-changeset 749ed760…` (refresh, first half) | 0 |
| C | `OBJECTUI_ROOT=SCRATCH bash scripts/build-console.sh` (refresh, second half; the CI step) | 0 |
| D | `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` | 0 |
| E | `pnpm check:console-sha` | 0 |
| F | `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp` (the dist stamp check) | 0 |

- In C, the new block's turbo build was 36 of 36 tasks cached.
- `pack 7 package(s)`: 16 s. The pin script's lockfile dependency-name check passed.
- The frozen install finished in 5.9 s, and the console built.
- A first run at `a532a18745` was also all exit 0.

**Item 4, with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` exported and the seven typeless, at `10e5579ba9`** (the final script; the later commit adds only the test):

- Before the run: `dist/index.d.ts` was ABSENT for all seven, with 0 declaration files under each `dist`.
- `build-console.sh` exited 0 and printed the `OS_SKIP_DTS` notice.
- After the run: PRESENT for all seven (spec 134 declaration files, lint 4, types 4, the rest 2).
- `gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, `check:console-sha` and `check:console-injection --require-stamp` each exited 0.

**Item 1, read off the objectui tree after the install:**
- `node_modules/.cache/objectstack/.stamp.json`: `source: external`, `root` = this worktree, `sha` = its HEAD.
- `node_modules/.pnpm`: 7 `@objectstack` entries, each `@objectstack+NAME@file+node_modules+.cache+objectstack+NAME…`.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: 0 registry-resolved `@objectstack/*` keys (14 `file:` keys).
- Each installed package's `dist/` against `packages/NAME/dist/` here: `diff -rq` exit 0 for all seven (control, spec against core: exit 1).
- **The bundled spec is this tree's.** In the build, the injection check reports no skew: the vendored spec is now this tree's, packed. Two-sided, run on a copy of the dist against the npm `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.3` tarball (the spec objectui's own pin `2c9bf9430a` was released as), `assert-console-spec-injection.mjs` exited 0: 10 of 10 injected-only descriptions present, the 1 next.3-only description absent.

**Item 2, the committed pin `0707b4ae37`** (`git cat-file -e 0707b4ae37:.objectstack-sha` exit 128; control `749ed760` exit 0), at `a532a18745`:
- This branch's script exited 0, and so did `origin/main` `97cb5c5a82`'s script run over the same tree.
- The two dists' `assets/` sha256 manifests are identical (3,450 files), and so are the injection stamps. `check:console-sha` and `check:console-injection --require-stamp` exited 0 after both.
- The new block's log lines: 0 (control: 3 in the item 4 log).
- The later commits touch only lines inside the `.objectstack-sha` block, and the test's first case pins that a pin without the file reaches the install with no closure build and no pin script.

**Item 3**, two scratch commits on `749ed760`, both carrying `.objectstack-sha`:
- `fac93cc890`: `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT` renamed out of the pin script, 6 occurrences to 0.
- `11ad951921`: the pin script deleted.
- Each exited 1 and printed `has no OBJECTSTACK_ROOT hook`. The install never ran, the pin script never ran, and the build tree has no `node_modules`.

**Before state (the dispatch's ablation; not committed).** The branch was disabled through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `ec24facf` to `33c9e4d0`, restore proved), and objectui `749ed760` built from a fresh tree. The frozen install died with `ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir '…/node_modules/.cache/objectstack/client'`, exit 254. ⚠️ That is not the `ERR_PNPM_LINKED_PKG_DIR_NOT_FOUND` the card's unlock note names; that code was measured on objectui's side, not in this script.

**The test:** `packages/spec/scripts/build-console-objectstack-root.test.ts`, in spec's `repo` project; `scripts/**` is already spec's declared cross-package input.
- It copies the real script into a temp framework root beside a temp objectui git repo. `pnpm` and the pin script are recording shims, and `pnpm install` exits 42, so reaching the install is the exit code.
- Five cases: no `.objectstack-sha`; no hook; hook (exact order: closure build, then the pin script with `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT` = the framework root and cwd = the build tree, then the install); inherited `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` (the closure build sees it unset, the install still sees `1`); a pin-script refusal.
- `vitest run --project repo` on it: 5 passed, 839 ms.
- Ablations, each through `ablation-replace.mjs` with the restore proved:
  - closure build inheriting `OS_SKIP_DTS`: 1 failed, 4 passed;
  - branch disabled: 4 failed, 1 passed;
  - restored: 5 passed, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json --listFiles`: exit 0, and the file is in the program.

## The dispatch's mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **Build closure.** Turbo dry runs at this branch show that every workflow filter builds all seven: ci.yml `--filter=@objectstack/client...` (37 tasks), cut-rc.yml `client...` + `spec...` (37), showcase-smoke.yml `@objectstack/example-showcase^...` (65), release.yml `pnpm run build` (83). Control: `--filter=@objectstack/types` builds spec and types only. So the script builds what it needs itself and **no workflow changes**. The PR is not on the governed register: `check-governed-merges.mjs --test`: NOT governed.
2. **Dependency names.** Confirmed: the pin script's lockfile check passed for objectui `749ed760` (pin `2c9bf9430a`) against this tree. Operator remedy: the refusal text above. Design alternative: in the report.
3. **The injections on the new branch.** They are redundant for "which spec and client ship". A rebuild of the console in the same objectui tree without them passes:
   - the two-sided probe against next.3 (3 of 10 injected-only present, the 1 next.3-only absent);
   - the client canary;
   - the single-zod canary.

   They are not neutral: with them the JS is 907 KB larger (34,623,558 against 33,716,662 bytes; `vendor-objectstack` 6,128,118 against 5,222,138), and the bundle carries more spec text. Kept, as ordered; a follow-up decision is in the report.
4. **The console-dist cache key** (`ci.yml`) under-covers the new branch. Core, types, formula, sdui-parser and lint now come from this tree, while the key carries only `packages/spec/package.json` and `tsup.config.ts` of them. For CONTENT that is the same accepted class as the client and the spec's content (the ruled cost model).
   - **New failure class:** the dependency-name refusal is a build FAILURE driven by the other six manifests. While the key hits, the Console Pin Gate never runs the pin script, so the refusal first fires where the console is built unconditionally: `cut-rc.yml`'s `pnpm objectui:build`, or `pnpm run release` in the publish step.
   - Not changed here (Tier H). A finding in the report: adding the six manifests to the key and the `console` filter costs no extra miss on Version Packages merges, because all seven are in one changesets `fixed` group with spec.

## Gates

- **Local, at `e497bf7535`:** the 80 families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives. 79 exited 0.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs a whole-tree `pnpm build`), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and CI's reading stands.
  - `pnpm check:console-sha` first read exit 1, against the dist my item 4 run left stamped `749ed760` after the pin was restored: the gate working. It re-read exit 0 with no dist, the CI lint state. Its substantive readings are the item 2 and item 4 rows above.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: 80 derived, 79 run, 1 NOT MEASURED (derived from the recorded exit 3), 0 unrun.
- **Also run:** `vitest run src/utils/console.not-built.test.ts test/console-resolve.test.ts` in `@objectstack/cli` (2 files, 30 tests passed); spec's `repo` project in full (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run test:repo`: 69 files, 1,130 tests passed); the scripts tsc above.
- **CI:** the Console Pin Gate does not run on a PR or in the queue (full battery only). Its first run of this change is `main`'s push battery after the merge, at today's pin, which is item 2's path.

## Changeset

None. Nothing in any package's `files[]` changes. At today's pin the console dist is byte-identical (item 2), and the bump that moves the pin writes its own `@objectstack/console` changeset. `skip-changeset` applies. ⛔ No label was written here: the dispatch forbade label writes, so the seat applies it.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `check-console-injection.mjs` says "between the injected and published spec" for a no-skew stamp. On this branch the vendored side is this tree's packed spec, not a published one.
- Item 3's message reads "no OBJECTSTACK_ROOT hook in scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs" also when that file is absent. It names the missing hook, as required.
- `packages/console/README.md` step 2 says opening the PR runs the Console Pin Gate. That has been false since the gate became full-battery only, and predates this change.
- The run that this dispatch resumed left its scratch objectui clone, a 1.6 GB build tree and its logs on disk, though the resume note said they were gone. This run removed them and re-measured everything.
